full_judgment: 17. Coming to the merit of the case it appears that P.W. 3 Ruba Akhter the victim girl herself has vividly narrated the whole occurrence and stated the circumstances very clearly. She stated in her evidence that on 4.11.89 at about 10/11 in the morning while the victim was alone in her house the accused came in and-sat at the verandah. The accused enquired about the father, mother, brother and sister of the victim and the victim stated that none of them are present. Her father went to the khaya, ghat. Mother, brother and sister having gone to the nearby village to see the ailing khala she was alone in the house. Being convinced that she was completely alone, the accused at once hatched at a plan while she was inside the room to bring out the wrapper of her father, the accused followed her and closed the door. She raised alarm but accused pressed her mouth by his hands and brought her down on the ground and violated her chastity. The victim girl raised hue and cry which attracted the attention of witnesses such as Bibi, Shahanoor, grand mother Safura and many others who came to her rescue but the accused fled away. Being ravaged and rapped and divested she in her mental agony plunged herself into the water. The person who assembled there heard the story and chased the accused up to the house of his father-in-law but on the assurance given by his mother-in-law but on the assurance given by his mother-in-law that she would settle the matter they came back. There very statements made in a natural way by a village girl of 14 is enough and there is no reason to disbelieve her testimony. Furthermore her evidence on this material particulars received due corroboration from many other witnesses. P.W. 5 Bibi who came to the place of occurrence on the alarm raised by the victim found that the door was locked up from inside and the victim girl stated that accused Tofazzal Hossain has been violated her chastity. This P.W. 5 Bibi also saw the accused to run away and she also found that the victim girl in a hid to save herself from the extreme dishonour plunged herself into the water of the tank and she remained there for about one hour and the inmates of the house took her to the house. P.W. 6 Nuruzzaman also corroborate the story of P.W. 5 that accused Tofazzal Hossain had violated the chastity of Kazal and further P.W. 7 Abdus Sobhan also corroborated the statements of P.W. 3 and 5. The evidence of P.W.8. Shahanara Khatun also found ample corroboration of the evidence of P.W. 3 P.W. 9 Safura Bibi also corroborated the material part of the story that accused Tofazzal Hossain had violated the chastity of Kazal. P.W. 10 Abdul Kader also made similar statements corroborating the evidence of P.W. 3. The overwhelming evidences of the P.Ws. who were quite independent and credibly witness, the provocation case cannot but be believed. The offence as committed by accused Tofazzal Hossain has further finds corroboration from the Medical Report, namely, the report of Dr. Nasrin Haq (P.W. 1). She stated in her evidence that she examined the victim girl Ruba Akhter Kazal duly identified by constable Abdul Khaleque and found marks of violence on her person arid opined that this is a case of rape and the evidence of the witnesses has clearly established that it is accused Tofazzal Hossain who committed the crime of rape on the victim Kazal. The leaned Judge has rightly found accused Tofazzal Hossain guilty of the offence under section 376 of the Penal Code. The learned Judge appears to have taken a very lenient view in matters of sentence. We do not find any ground to interfere with the judgment passed by the learned Judge.
